basic_info.main_problem: I keep worrying that clients will think I am lying to or deceiving them in my real estate work.
basic_info.core_demands: 当这些侵入性思维影响我的Work表现和与上司的关系时,我决定寻求咨询.我想在Work和与客户互动中更自信,减少Anxiety.

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being trusted
如果我not能完美表现,就会被negate并失去Work

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果客户在任何细节上表现出怀疑,就说明我not诚实或not专业
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我安慰与事实核查,强调信息准确性以求证明自己
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will think I am lying or deceiving them.

special_situations.event: Preparing a property showing or reviewing listings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能做到完美准备,客户一定not会信任我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复检查材料,Over-preparation以避免任何错误
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果有一点遗漏,客户就会认为我not可信.

special_situations.event: Recalling possible client reactions at work
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果曾有客户Silence或表情冷淡,就意味着大多数客户都not信任我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces in-depth communication with clients, instead emphasizing procedures and facts to reduce risk
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 所有客户都会觉得我not诚实.

special_situations.event: Considers the impact of the relationship with the boss on work evaluation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我表现稍有not足,就会被认为是not专业,进而丢掉Work
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 对Work细节过度谨慎,自我苛责以确保have not任何被攻击的点
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may lose my job because of this.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be trusted, recognized and affirmed by clients and boss
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被视为not诚实,被negate并失去Work与关系
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being questioned through perfect performance and fact-checking
Staying cautious and self-restrained to maintain a sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: 易被质疑,not被信任的从业者
object_relations.object_representation: Critical clients who would doubt her motives

object_relations.self_representation: A subordinate who needs perfection to earn recognition
object_relations.object_representation: Boss / authority with coexisting pressure and judgment

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当与客户直接交流或准备展示时,感到对方可能not信任自己
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者将客户的中性信号解读为对其not诚实的判断(移情:Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以平稳,专业的语气强调事实与流程,罗列证据与细节,尽量not涉及感受与not确定性.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被询问是否向亲密朋友分享Anxiety或在关系中表达担忧时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing that expressing vulnerability may trigger negative evaluations from others or cause more trouble
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 简单承认存在担忧但not展开细节,语气克制,若对话深入则Displacement到具体Work事项.

在职场中感到他人not会信任自己,产生隔离感
在与上司的恋爱关系与Work压力中感到必须完美,体验到Restricted choices与外界期待的束缚
outcomes: 担心失去Work导致not yet来Restricted choices

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept in themselves to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language expressions include: 'He is looking down on me' and 'They want to exclude me'.
manifestations: 频繁假设客户会认为她not诚实或欺骗
Attributes inner doubt to the client's thoughts

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Persistent self-checking and fact verification to avoid errors
担心表现not够完美而过度谨慎

exception_events.target_problem: 在与客户互动的情境中,来访者通常会担心被认为not诚实,导致Anxiety升级并影响Work表现.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 某位客户对她的房源搜索表示非常感激,并写了感谢信;当时她的服务被积极认可,Anxiety相对减轻.
exception_events.reason: not同支持:客户提供了积极反馈与感谢;not同情境:业务流程顺畅,信息透明;做法not同:保持诚实开放的沟通与专业展示.

exception_events.target_problem: 在房产展示或客户看房的场景中,来访者通常会Anticipation负面评价并紧张失误.
exception_events.unique_outcome: During one house viewing, a couple praised her professionalism and performance; the interaction went smoothly, and she was better able to engage in the present.
exception_events.reason: not同支持:客户的即时称赞与正向互动;做法not同:专注当前需求,提供清晰信息;情境not同:展示流程顺利,without意外干扰.

positive_force: 曾获得客户的感谢与称赞,说明具备专业能力与Good服务
Willing to seek counseling and stay positive
Able to do fact-checking and self-monitoring, values integrity
